title.narrative: Personalbidrag till Europeiska utrikestjänsten (EEAS), Human Rights 1, Global Division
Secondment of personnel to the European External Action Service

description.narrative: Domstolsverket tillhandahåller personal som tjänstgör vid den Europeiska utrikestjänsten (EEAS)

The Swedish National Courts Administration (SNCA) has been assigned by the government to recruit and make personnel available for missions within the framework EU Common Security and Defence Policy (CSDP), and also to strive to second personnel to the international organisations’ headquarters. The SNCA has seconded a national expert for a period of two years to the EEAS in Brussels who works in with human rights issues within CSDP missions.
Domstolsverkets utsände ska bidrag till uppfyllnaden av insatsens mandat.
